notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed a Food this turn, or at least three cards have left your graveyard this turn.
Bonecache Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Bonecache Overseer by tapping it and paying 1 life, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bonecache Overseer.
Repeat.
